unrestrained.description: Classical dual-slope percentage restraint, no harmonic blocking

as_coded.description: R1: Unselective cross-blocking (any phase k2>15% or k5>35% blocks all)

cross_active.description: R2: Active cross-blocking (only phases with Id > 0.30 pu cross-block)

per_phase.description: R3: Phase-independent restraint (standard industrial commercial practice)
